summary: Install-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to webhook.site
details: setup.py overrides the install command to collect the installer's hostname and resolved local IP address and POST them as JSON to the hardcoded URL https://webhook.site/17a7df2e-3d56-4c5a-b7a9-9a95fe58a533 during `pip install`, tagged with the package name and version. The beacon fires unconditionally at install time with no user disclosure or opt-out, and the package itself provides no documented functionality — the shipped code is a proof-of-concept beacon with placeholder author metadata. The exfiltrated data is limited to host identifiers (hostname, IP) rather than credentials, but the install-time network callback to a third-party collector enables correlation of installations with the operator of the webhook endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
